item.title: Texas Senate race prices Talarico ahead of Paxton on Kalshi and Polymarket — Oct 14, 2026 · 5:45 PM ET
item.description: - **Texas Senate race prices Talarico ahead of Paxton on Kalshi and Polymarket** — Action Network reports Polymarket prices James Talarico at 65 cents and Kalshi at 64 cents against Ken Paxton at 37 cents in the Texas Senate race for the seat John Cornyn is vacating. Early voting starts October 19 ahead of the November 3 election, with recent polling within a point or two. ([Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/news/texas-senate-race-odds-kalshi-polymarket-texas-senate-predictions-talarico-vs-paxton-polls-analysis))

item.title: Sixth Circuit ruling lets Tennessee and Ohio apply gambling laws to Kalshi sports contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 5:45 PM ET
item.description: - **Sixth Circuit ruling lets Tennessee and Ohio apply gambling laws to Kalshi sports contracts** — ReadWrite reports the Sixth Circuit ruled on September 25 that Tennessee and Ohio can regulate Kalshi sports-event contracts under state gambling laws, finding Kalshi had not shown the contracts qualify as swaps under exclusive CFTC jurisdiction. The decision vacated a Tennessee injunction and adds to the split among federal appeals courts. ([ReadWrite](https://readwrite.com/kalshi-prediction-markets-gambling-laws/))

item.title: Polymarket trader loses about 147,000 dollars on Eagles after late Jaguars field goal — Oct 14, 2026 · 5:45 PM ET
item.description: - **Polymarket trader loses about 147,000 dollars on Eagles after late Jaguars field goal** — A Polymarket trader put about 146,700 dollars on the Philadelphia Eagles and was close to a 623,449 dollar payout before Jacksonville won 19-17 in London on a 57-yard field goal as time expired. The position had traded up to 99 cents before settling at zero. ([15 Minute News](https://www.15minutenews.com/article/2026/10/12/285007843/polymarket-whale-loses-147k-eagles-bet-after-a-lastsecond-57yard-kick/))

item.title: Polymarket trader turns 7.46 million dollar Colombia position into about 2.71 million dollars profit — Oct 14, 2026 · 5:45 PM ET
item.description: - **Polymarket trader turns 7.46 million dollar Colombia position into about 2.71 million dollars profit** — CoinStats reports a Polymarket trader accumulated 10.17 million yes shares on Colombia to beat Uzbekistan at an average 73.3 cents, committing about 7.46 million dollars. Colombia won in regulation, putting the position near 10.17 million dollars at settlement for about 2.71 million dollars in profit. item.title: PredictIt prepares new exchange launch after CFTC contract market and clearing approvals — Oct 14, 2026 · 5:45 PM ET
item.description: - **PredictIt prepares new exchange launch after CFTC contract market and clearing approvals** — Decrypt reports PredictIt operator Aristotle received CFTC approval to operate as a designated contract market and a derivatives clearing organization, and plans a new exchange for U.S. traders. item.title: Robinhood to be first broker to offer Cboe earnings-linked event contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 2:00 PM ET

item.title: CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:45 PM ET
item.description: - **CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts** — The CFTC has proposed rules that would codify sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as federally regulated swaps, while carving conventional casino-style gambling products out of that definition. The agency says the change would clarify that event contracts fall within its exclusive jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([CoinSpectator](https://coinspectator.com/mainstream/2026/10/10/why-the-cftc-is-rewriting-swap-rules-for-prediction-markets-and-how-it-shifts-the-balance-of-power/))

item.description: - **Polymarket bank-failure bets draw UK scrutiny over market integrity risks** — Bets on Polymarket's offshore platform on whether major global banks will fail have drawn scrutiny in the United Kingdom, where the Financial Conduct Authority has said the financial prediction products it examined function similarly to binary options, banned for British retail consumers since 2019. item.title: Kalshi CEO says state-led oversight of prediction markets would push firms offshore — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi CEO says state-led oversight of prediction markets would push firms offshore** — Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour said on October 14 that if U.S. courts side with states claiming gambling authority over prediction markets, firms in the sector will be forced to move overseas. The comments came as courts remain split over whether the CFTC or state regulators should oversee event contracts. ([CoinDesk](https://Www.coindesk.com/policy/2026/10/14/kalshi-ceo-says-state-led-oversight-of-u-s-prediction-markets-would-push-them-out))

item.title: CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers** — The CFTC has proposed a rule defining event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act, paired with an interim rule excluding casino games and traditional sportsbook wagers from that definition. Both actions are subject to a 30-day public comment period. ([Virlan](https://www.virlan.co/igaming/cftc-proposes-rules-classifying-prediction-market-event-contracts-as-swaps-while-excluding-sportsbooks/))

item.title: NFL tells Supreme Court sports prediction contracts are gambling, not swaps — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **NFL tells Supreme Court sports prediction contracts are gambling, not swaps** — The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to hear New Jersey's case against Kalshi, arguing that sports contracts on prediction markets are gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps. The league cited game integrity and consumer protection concerns, including trading tied to NFL games. ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-10-08-nfl-amicus-brief-supreme-court-kalshi-new-jersey-prediction-markets-418064))

item.title: Kalshi and Polymarket prepare perpetual futures markets for U.S. traders — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi and Polymarket prepare perpetual futures markets for U.S. traders** — Kalshi and Polymarket are preparing perpetual futures products that would let U.S. traders hold leveraged positions without a fixed settlement date, with sample interfaces showing crypto, metals and stock contracts at up to 10 times leverage. The launch follows CFTC approval for Kalshi affiliate Kinetic Markets to offer margin trading as a futures commission merchant. ([Deadspin](https://deadspin.com/prediction-markets/legal-news/perpetual-futures-markets-coming-soon-to-kalshi-polymarket/))

item.description: - **Kalshi files for Ohio and Tennessee rehearings based on CFTC new swaps rule** — Kalshi filed a motion for rehearing in the Sixth Circuit citing the CFTC Notice of Proposed Rulemaking published October 9, which seeks to include sports, politics, cultural and weather event contracts in the definition of swaps. The Sixth Circuit had ruled in September that Ohio and Tennessee could regulate Kalshi sports contracts under state gambling laws. item.description: - **Midterm election betting surges on Polymarket and Kalshi as insider-trading concerns persist** — Reuters reported on October 14 that trading on U.S. midterm outcomes has surged this year on Polymarket and Kalshi, covering control of Congress and individual races. item.description: - **Kalshi fee structure turns even-money prices into minus 107 for takers, analysis shows** — An analysis of Kalshi pricing explains that a 50 cent contract shown as even money costs minus 107 when taking the price and minus 102 when the order waits. Long-shot prices are affected most, with a plus 900 screen price returning plus 841 after fees. ([BettingPros](https://www.bettingpros.com/articles/how-kalshi-sports-betting-works/))

item.title: Polymarket prices Democrats at 91 percent for the House and 64 percent for the Senate in midterms — Oct 14, 2026 · 4:00 AM ET
item.description: - **Polymarket prices Democrats at 91 percent for the House and 64 percent for the Senate in midterms** — Polymarket gave Democrats a 91 percent chance of winning the House and a 64 percent chance of taking the Senate as of Tuesday, October 13. Kalshi balance-of-power markets also listed a Democratic sweep as the leading outcome, with individual Senate races favoring Democrats in several states. ([NorthJersey.com](https://www.northjersey.com/story/news/2026/10/13/who-will-win-2026-midterms-winning-midterm-elections-latest-polls-odds-predictions-polymarket-kalshi/92232625007/))

item.title: Kalshi and Polymarket midterm markets face insider-trading scrutiny over knowable contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 4:00 AM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi and Polymarket midterm markets face insider-trading scrutiny over knowable contracts** — An analysis by the Anti-Corruption Data Collective highlighted vulnerability to political insider trading on granular midterm contracts, which have generated more than 20 million dollars in volume. Researchers flagged correlated trades on a Kalshi contract tied to a Maine Senate candidate withdrawal shortly before news became public. ([Bonus.com](https://www.bonus.com/news/midterm-prediction-markets-draw-insider-trading-scrutiny-as-kalshi-polymarket-expand-elect/))

item.title: Kalshi ends its volume rewards program effective October 13 — Oct 14, 2026 · 4:00 AM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi ends its volume rewards program effective October 13** — KalshiEX notified the CFTC on September 28 that it is terminating its Volume Incentive Program effective no earlier than October 13, replacing a previous end date in 2027. The program had awarded eligible participants a share of per-market rewards based on qualifying trading volume, and no replacement was announced in the filing. ([Crypto Economy](https://crypto-economy.com/kalshi-ends-volume-rewards-program/))

item.title: Prediction market volume reaches 96.8 billion dollars in 30 days with Kalshi handling 76 percent — Oct 14, 2026 · 4:00 AM ET
item.description: - **Prediction market volume reaches 96.8 billion dollars in 30 days with Kalshi handling 76 percent** — Tracked prediction market volume totaled 96.8 billion dollars in contracts over the 30 days to October 13, with Kalshi handling 76 percent of it. The tracker reported 3.4 billion dollars traded in the last 24 hours across venues including Polymarket US, DraftKings Predictions and ProphetX. item.title: Kalshi prices 62 percent chance Bitcoin falls below 80,000 dollars in October — Oct 14, 2026 · 4:00 AM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi prices 62 percent chance Bitcoin falls below 80,000 dollars in October** — Kalshi assigned a 62 percent probability to Bitcoin trading below 80,000 dollars during October, with about 244,836 dollars in volume on that market. Polymarket showed rising probabilities on some deeper downside targets over the same period.
